type: string (base64 on Bedrock, file upload on v2beta)
summary: The input image the operation works from.
combines: Supported on: Required on all edit endpoints except style-transfer (which uses `init_image`), on control/sketch, control/structure, control/style, and all three upscale endpoints. Optional on generate/ultra and generate/sd3 where it switches on image-to-image.
On SD3.5 and Ultra, supplying `image` requires `strength` and puts the request in image-to-image mode.
On inpaint and erase, an alpha channel in `image` is used as the mask when no explicit `mask` is passed.
